confirmedLocalCodeGaps.title: Automatic resume of candidateReady bypasses its own expiry-advancement policy
confirmedLocalCodeGaps.trigger: Prepare a valid same-identity candidate manually using a still-valid lease whose minimum profile expiry is equal to or earlier than the currently installed App minimum expiry; enable or resume automatic renewal after its throttle is due.
confirmedLocalCodeGaps.actual: The candidateReady branch executes renewalSigningContext and submitPreparedRenewalOwned before reading actual App expiry. Those paths validate current signatures, identity, generation and non-expiry, but do not compare candidate expiry with current App expiry. It may upload/Upgrade and report receiptObserved without extending the effective App validity.

evidence.observation: early candidateReady submission precedes current-App material read at 583 and normal-path renewedExpiry comparison at 618-619
manual prepare and renewalSigningContext require a current valid lease but no expiry advancement
candidate construction and re-verification validate exact bytes/material/generation but no relative-expiry condition
candidate is required to be valid now; metadata compatibility does not imply extension

confirmedLocalCodeGaps.nextLocalAction: Apply the existing current-App expiry-advancement rule to the exact persisted candidate on automatic candidateReady resume before any authenticated connection. Preserve the ready candidate and avoid refreshing/replacing its material generation on rejection. Add a controlled negative regression and retain the interrupted extending-candidate recovery case.
confirmedLocalCodeGaps.limits: Static reachable-path proof, not a newly executed reproduction. receiptObserved remains a transport observation; no false installed/automaticVerified flag is asserted.

confirmedLocalCodeGaps.title: The submitted transaction has no implemented safe terminal handoff to a subsequent renewal cycle
confirmedLocalCodeGaps.trigger: An Upgrade has an authenticated receipt, and a later genuine process supplies matching candidate material plus matching normal-load data observations; the next renewal becomes due.
confirmedLocalCodeGaps.actual: Both observations are stored without a phase transition. Reported-complete remote cleanup retains receiptObserved. Every later automatic attempt selects recoveryRequired, while create/new prepare requires the predecessor to be retired and refuses any submitted phase. Current APIs cannot begin the second renewal cycle even after these observations exist.

evidence.observation: phase inventory has no post-submission terminal state; create permits only a retired predecessor
current-process material and normal-load observations do not finalize a submitted transaction
reportedComplete cleanup leaves the receiptObserved phase unchanged
submitted/lookup phases cannot be retired or superseded before another prepare
all submitted phases unconditionally take the recovery-only automatic branch

confirmedLocalCodeGaps.nextLocalAction: Specify and implement a narrowly authenticated post-submission terminal transition, including crash/reopen and next-cycle admission regression, without treating same-version Lookup, a receipt, or same-process reads as installation/cold-launch proof. The local transition mechanism can be implemented and controlled-tested; acceptance of real installation and OS image/cold-launch evidence remains external.
confirmedLocalCodeGaps.limits: Conservative current behavior prevents duplicate Upgrade; it is an absent continuing-renewal capability, not an assertion that current code falsely completes installation. No automatic deletion or unsafe Lookup-based retirement is recommended.

expiryPolicyAssessment.freshAutomatic: AppSession 618-619 requires renewed minimum profile expiry strictly later than current actual App minimum expiry, then revalidates the lease; 48h is a trigger lead, not a promised duration.
expiryPolicyAssessment.certificateReuse: Vault.refreshProfiles 424-430 requires each component expiry to advance against the authenticated old publication baseline.
expiryPolicyAssessment.newCSRAndReconcile: Vault.publish 633-665 independently verifies current profiles, target device and current non-expiry. It does not compare with old App expiry; the normal automatic outer branch supplies that minimum-expiry check.
expiryPolicyAssessment.manual: Explicit prepare/submit accept valid same-identity packages and report candidate/transport observations. Absence of relative-expiry enforcement is not separately classified as a bug in these manual APIs, because they do not report completed renewal.
expiryPolicyAssessment.minimumRemainingWindow: No numeric minimum beyond current validity and strict automatic expiry advancement is specified by the inspected contract; no invented 48h-validity requirement or arbitrary safety-margin bug is asserted.
